parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, border/facility restriction, or documented pattern of violence or police targeting of visitors is evidenced, and prosecutorial guidance treats SOGI hostility as weighing toward prosecution, which mitigates. Against this: conservative climate with church/official/chief opposition, 2024 cabinet direction to draft a policy banning LGBTQIA+ advocacy framed as contrary to values (form/enforcement unsourced, so not treated as an enacted visitor ban), no visitor-usable anti-discrimination recourse, and no data the prosecutorial guidance operates in practice—only one prosecuted lesbian-violence case in 2016. Marriage and teaching-service protections are resident-facing and not credited. Thin data resolves below acceptance-with-working-remedies jurisdictions, but no universal exposure or organised targeting is documented.
